description: This file defines a Flask route for a health check endpoint using Flask-Smorest and MethodView. It creates a Blueprint named 'health' and a single route '/' that responds with a health status message.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flask view class that handles GET requests to check the health/status of the service.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Handles GET requests for the health check endpoint, returning a simple JSON message indicating the service is healthy.

ctags.name: blp
ctags.pattern: /^blp = Blueprint("health", __name__, url_prefix="\/", description="Health check endpoint for moni/
